name: @luke/agent-runner
description: The runner in a coding agent's sandbox: Claude Code through the Agent SDK or Codex through its app-server, Luke's messages in on stdin, the harness's messages out to Luke

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/agent-runner.mjs --define:process.env.LUKE_RUNNER_VERSION='"'$npm_package_version'"' --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
